description: Analyzes the current context window's live health and provides optimization recommendations (HEALTHY/MONITOR/WARNING/CRITICAL), manually triggered.

evals.name: Direct live-window health question
evals.prompt: how full is my context right now
evals.expected_output: Asks the user to run /context and share the output (the reliable source for the HEALTHY/MONITOR/WARNING/CRITICAL assessment), falling back to indirect estimation only if /context output isn't available. Produces a Context Window Analysis report following the template in references/context-window-examples.md (Estimated Status, Observable Indicators, Assessment, Recommendations), using the real 40/80/90 thresholds aligned with context-monitor.py.

evals.name: Broader footprint audit request (should defer to context-audit)
evals.prompt: audit my skills and CLAUDE.md for context bloat
evals.expected_output: Does NOT produce a live-context-window health report. This request is explicitly out of scope per the skill's own 'When NOT to Use' section -- a broader skills/CLAUDE.md/plugin/MCP footprint audit belongs to context-audit instead. The response should point at context-audit (or a comparable footprint-auditing capability) rather than attempting the live-window health check this skill actually does.

evals.name: One Warning sign, no /context output (estimate gives MONITOR)
evals.prompt:
Situation: a long session (about 60 turns, many file reads). Responses have been slower than usual. There are no truncation warnings and no auto-compact message, and early decisions are still recalled correctly. The user has not shared /context output.
User message: responses feel slow, what's going on with my context?
evals.expected_output: Reports a MONITOR estimate right away, labelled an estimate, with 'keep going and plan a /compact at a natural break'; does not tell the user to run /compact or /clear now; asks for /context output for a measured figure.

evals.name: Two Warning signs, no /context output (estimate gives WARNING)
evals.prompt:
Situation: a long session. Responses have been slower than usual and the agent has twice forgotten a decision made earlier in the session. There is no auto-compact message and no truncation warning. The user has not shared /context output.
User message: how full is my context right now
evals.expected_output: Reports a WARNING estimate right away, labelled an estimate; recommends running /context and compacting only if the measured percentage confirms it, not running /compact or /clear now.

evals.name: Unrelated failed command is not a CRITICAL sign
evals.prompt:
Situation: a short session (5 turns). The last Bash command failed because of a typo in a file name. There are no truncation warnings, no auto-compact message and no memory gaps. The user has not shared /context output.
User message: how full is my context right now
evals.expected_output: Does not report CRITICAL: treats the typo failure as unrelated to the context (no indicator at all), giving HEALTHY labelled an estimate with 'no action needed', and does not tell the user to run /compact or /clear now.

evals.name: Very slow responses as the only sign (one Warning indicator)
evals.prompt:
Situation: a short session (6 turns, few file reads). Responses have been very slow for the last few turns. There are no truncation warnings, no auto-compact message, no memory gaps and no failed operations. The user has not shared /context output.
User message: responses are very slow, is my context full?
evals.expected_output: Reports a MONITOR estimate right away, labelled an estimate: very slow responses alone count as one Warning indicator, not CRITICAL or WARNING. Asks for /context output and does not tell the user to run /compact or /clear now.

evals.name: Repeated auto-compact messages without a Critical sign (WARNING)
evals.prompt:
Situation: a long session (about 90 turns). An auto-compact message has appeared three times. Responses are normal speed, earlier decisions are still recalled correctly, the conversation is not truncated and no operation has failed. The user has not shared /context output.
User message: auto-compact keeps triggering, how full is my context?
evals.expected_output: Reports a WARNING estimate right away, labelled an estimate, not CRITICAL: auto-compact messages alone map to WARNING. Recommends running /context and compacting only if the measured percentage confirms it, not running /compact or /clear now.

uncovered: A request for the automatic hook-driven compaction-timing behavior itself -- defers to strategic-compact
testing_validation_coverage.coverage_note: Eval 3 (2026-11-20) covers the declared 'responses feel slow' scenario. Evals 4 and 5 (2026-11-20) are extra: they cover Step 2's estimate mapping for two Warning signs and for an unrelated failure. Evals 6 and 7 (2026-11-24) are extra: very slow responses as the only sign, and repeated auto-compact messages without a Critical sign.
